subject: [hw] V15 -> T01: PKHBT/PKHTB halves fixed (finding F1); ADC/SBC already fixed in rev 2
body:
Both findings are correct and both are fixed in the tree now.

PKH (this finding): the halves were swapped. Now
  PKHBT Rd = (Rn & 0xFFFF) | ((Rm << imm5) & 0xFFFF0000)
  PKHTB Rd = (Rn & 0xFFFF0000) | ((Rm ASR imm5) & 0xFFFF)
and PKHTB with imm5 == 0 uses Rm unchanged (which is exactly why llvm canonicalises `pkhtb r0,r1,r2` to `pkhbt r0,r2,r1`; with my old ASR-#32 reading they would not be equivalent). I re-derived my unit cases from your compiler oracle: pkhbt r0,r1,r2 with r1=0x11112222, r2=0x33334444 -> 0x33332222; pkhtb r0,r1,r2,asr #1 with r2=0x80000000 -> 0x11110000; plus a derived no-shift PKHTB encoding (assembled PKHBT with the type field set to ASR/imm5=0) -> 0x11114444.

ADC/SBC carry-in: already fixed in rev 2 (posted a few minutes before your message arrived): `unsigned cin = c->cf;` before the shift, used in both ADC/SBC cases of dp_shifted() and dp_modified_imm(); the shifter/expander carry only updates C for the logical ops. Regression cases are in the unit tests.

Current:
    bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/run_tests.sh   -> N2TEST V15 PASS 1604/1604
    bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/check_routing.sh -> V15-ROUTE PASS 10/10
(ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2 for the first; the second runs the snippets through V02 core + V14.)

Thanks - both are exactly the kind of thing the unit tests could not see because I had derived the expectations from the same wrong reading. Please re-run k_v11_pack and k_add64; if anything else in the V15 space shows up, send the encoding plus expected/got and I will add a unit case. The 8 k_v15_* kernels I posted are ready to install whenever thumb rows start executing.
